analysis.title: Evercore Inc. (EVR): First Take: Well-rounded beat, across Advisory and ECM revenue, and robust expense discipline
key_insights: EVR reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $4.28, 84% above GSe of $2.33 and 70% above Visible Alpha consensus of $2.52.
GS expects a positive response to results given pre-tax income 70% above consensus, driven by material beats in advisory and ECM.
Total revenue of ~$1.2bn came in 28% above GSe and 32% above consensus.
Advisory fees of ~$1.0bn were 34% above GSe and 38% above consensus, and up 14% YoY, driven by more revenue from large transactions and more advisory fees earned.

Reported advisory revenue was 2.5x Dealogic revenue (adjusted for estimated net pull-forward), vs 1.6x last quarter and higher than the past 6 quarters, raising the question of 4Q26 pull-forward into 3Q26.
Underwriting (ECM) revenue was 20% above the Street and up 27% YoY, driven by higher average fee size. Institutional equities came in 4% below the Street and down 4% YoY.
Adjusted operating margin of 22.9% was ~475bps above consensus, driven by a ~425bps non-comp ratio beat and a ~50bps comp ratio beat.
The 3Q26 adjusted comp ratio was 63.0%, down 50bps QoQ, with YTD comp ratio at 63.5%, down 180bps YoY. Adjusted comp expense rose 9% YoY.
Non-comp expenses fell 5% QoQ despite 18% higher revenue QoQ, though they were 2% above consensus.
EVR bought back 0.5mn shares for $152mn including net share settle, in line with GSe of 0.6mn, and held its dividend at 89 cents, in line with GSe.
GS maintains a Buy rating with a 12-month price target of $331 based on 14.5x Q5-Q8 P/E, implying 27.4% upside from $259.86.

GS wants clarity on pull-forward effects on 4Q26 seasonality, sponsor M&A outlook given higher rates, restructuring and secondary advisory contribution, M&A backlog (Dealogic backlog up 38% YoY as of 10/26/26), ECM trajectory, comp ratio cadence, and non-comp trajectory.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $4.28 beat GSe and consensus on advisory and ECM strength plus expense discipline. GS expects a positive stock reaction.

earnings_insights: EVR 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $4.28 vs GSe $2.33 and Visible Alpha consensus $2.52, printed 10/28/26.
Total revenue ~$1.2bn reported, 28% above GSe and 32% above consensus.

Advisory fees ~$1.0bn reported, 34% above GSe and 38% above consensus, up 14% YoY. Underwriting revenue reported 20% above the Street and up 27% YoY. Institutional equities reported 4% below the Street and down 4% YoY.
Adjusted operating margin reported 22.9%, ~475bps above consensus. Adjusted comp ratio reported 63.0%, down 50bps QoQ and about 50bps better than the Street. YTD comp ratio 63.5%, down 180bps YoY.
GS estimates: 3Q26E EPS $2.33 (now printed at $4.28), 4Q26E $5.41, 1Q27E $5.22. FY26E EPS $18.23, FY27E $21.06, FY28E $24.63. FY26E revenue $4,713.7mn, FY27E $5,338.6mn.
Share repurchase: 0.5mn shares for $152mn including net share settle, vs GSe 0.6mn. Dividend maintained at $0.89.
risk_factors: Weaker M&A backlogs translating into weaker revenue expectations.
Longer time to completion pushing out M&A and restructuring revenue.
Higher compensation expense pressuring pre-tax margins.
Longer-term share losses through slower market or vertical expansion than competitors.
Possible pull-forward of 4Q26 revenue into 3Q26 weakening typical 4Q seasonality.
Sponsor M&A outlook given higher interest rates.
